thesis: Keep the ACME position at zero. Revenue and diluted EPS rose about 11%, and cash exceeds debt. The bankruptcy of a customer described as material to the current quarter puts near-term earnings at risk. The supplied 100 close predates the report, and the evidence does not quantify the revenue at risk or any replacement revenue.

exit_conditions.text: Reassess the hold when updated evidence quantifies the expected earnings impact of the bankruptcy and a fresh observation shows the price after the report.
